case_metadata.case_summary: YachtCo is a US luxury motor yacht manufacturer facing declining profitability. The candidate must diagnose the issue across new yacht sales and repairs, evaluate steel versus fiberglass hull costs, and recommend a turnaround strategy.

Canoodle is a mobile dating app with strong user popularity but no profitability. The candidate must diagnose a revenue problem, evaluate monetization options, and recommend where to launch a premium service.

Cackalacky Construction is a school-building contractor with stagnant growth that wants to double revenue in three years. The candidate must assess potential state markets, evaluate Texas competitive dynamics, and recommend an entry strategy.

Sardine Airlines is an ultra-low-cost carrier facing declining profit margins amid pressure from competitors. The candidate must analyze the statement of operations, identify cost drivers, and recommend SG&A cost reductions.

case_metadata.case_name: The Run of the Mill NOWOCO
case_metadata.case_summary: NOWOCO is a German construction-materials manufacturer experiencing falling profitability and poor order fulfillment despite a demand surge. The candidate must analyze operational capacity, customer profitability, and volume reallocation.

Dealer Jack’s is a US East Coast grocery retailer whose profits have stagnated despite industry growth. The candidate must diagnose the role of product mix, compare national and private-label brands, and evaluate a private-label penetration strategy.

Minty Fresh Co., a dominant US mouthwash brand, is losing market share and profit to new competitors. The candidate must analyze competitive dynamics, evaluate pricing and volume trade-offs, and recommend actions to reverse the decline.

An Off-Broadway theatre is trying to improve gross profit after changes to its actor cost structure. The candidate must analyze revenue, seating, pricing, and alternative revenue opportunities before recommending a pricing strategy.

Galactica is an on-premise data warehousing and analytics company losing profitability as cloud competitors gain share. The candidate must evaluate country-level performance and recommend cost-cutting actions, including possible market exits.

PrimeCo is an aerospace and defense prime contractor with declining profits despite rising revenue. The candidate must diagnose rising supplier component costs, analyze SubPrime Co.’s economics, and recommend supplier-improvement actions.

DevCo is a global medical device manufacturer facing margin and market-share pressure after expanding its product portfolio. The candidate must assess portfolio overlap, evaluate product-line attractiveness, and decide whether to launch a new product.

A large pharmaceutical company wants to double its rare-disease business in five years. The candidate must size organic growth, identify the revenue gap, and evaluate acquisitions as a path to reach the target.

Phone Com has acquired a satellite television company and needs to create value from the merger. The candidate must identify synergies, propose differentiated products, and assess new growth opportunities in the US and South America.

Walter Black Industries is a car wash chemical manufacturer with stagnant revenue after acquisitions. The candidate must identify ways to grow revenue by 30 percent without lowering margins, focusing on competitive benchmarking and pricing optimization.

A large CPG company is under pressure from an activist investor seeking actions to increase stock price and company performance. The candidate must evaluate short- and long-term value levers, including restructuring, low-cost sourcing, and divestitures.

Orange Yoga Studio is an upscale New York yoga studio whose profits have declined after rent and salary increases. The candidate must analyze class economics, utilization, capacity, and scheduling changes to restore profitability.

The Everything Retailer is a mass retailer facing stagnant year-over-year sales growth. The candidate must diagnose the growth issue, evaluate a new smaller-store format, and use NPV analysis to decide whether to build Local Market stores.

Purple Pill Company is a pharmaceutical company facing revenue decline and a looming patent loss on a major acid reflux drug. The candidate must identify revenue drivers and evaluate options to preserve revenue and profit after patent expiration.
